title: The Budget's £100 Energy Payment… Based on What Your Home Was Worth in 1991 😱🏠 #shorts
description:
The Budget's £100 energy payment goes to 20 million homes from January, and it's based on your council tax band, not your income.

What changed (Budget 2026, 28 October): a £2.6 billion Household Energy Payment of £100 for households in England in council tax bands A to D, from January 2027, for up to 20 million households, delivered through the council tax system. Councils get £100 million to help households in bands above A to D. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland get funding for similar support.

The strange part: in England your council tax band is set by what your home would have been worth on 1 April 1991 (VOA). Band D is a home worth up to £88,000 back then; band E is £88,001 to £120,000. So the payment follows the band, not what you earn or what your energy bill is.

Sources: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/budget-2026-document/budget-2026-html · https://www.gov.uk/government/news/budget-2026-breathing-space-for-today-hope-for-the-future · https://www.gov.uk/guidance/understand-how-council-tax-bands-are-assessed

A £100 energy payment based on what your home was worth in 1991: fair or not? Comment 👇
